title: Pivot the Line
author: Jacqui Grennan
problems: Row 1 "down the hall and turn alone towards neighbor, 4 steps, rejoin hands in line of four": a dancer has to move 1.28 m in one beat, faster than a walk.
choices: A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
A gyre goes by the right shoulder, facing each other, with no hands.
The 1s end their swing side by side in the middle of the set facing down, the way they progress.
A swing that ends facing down the hall is drawn ending facing across; the down the hall that follows turns the lines.

ones do si do once across the set
